definition: A person or thing that is a perfect example of a quality.
exampleSentence: Her serene demeanor during the debate was the epitome of grace under pressure.

definition: Dangerously steep; done suddenly without careful thought.
exampleSentence: The company experienced a precipitous decline in shareholder confidence.
Smartphones have become a ubiquitous feature of contemporary social life.
The historical link between the two archaeological artifacts remains tenuous.
Her extensive humanitarian work exemplifies the spirit of selfless public service.
The supreme court nominee possessed impeccable credentials in constitutional jurisprudence.

definition: Deep and far-reaching consequences across domains.
exampleSentence: The dissolution of the bilateral missile pact will carry profound repercussions for global security.

definition: A bitterly harsh expression of sharp disapproval.
exampleSentence: The parliamentary ombudsman delivered a scathing rebuke to the intelligence directorate for unlawful surveillance.

definition: A very weak, slight, or unsubstantiated link.
exampleSentence: Forensic specialists dismissed the disputed hair follicle as exhibiting only a tenuous connection to the crime scene.

definition: Connected so tightly or intimately that separation is impossible.
exampleSentence: Environmental stewardship and Indigenous territorial sovereignty are inextricably linked across the Amazonian basin.
